text:
maria: FYI, during the eu TLS rekey maintenance this morning we saw a class of SSE sessions that stayed TCP-connected but stopped receiving event frames for ~30-90s, then resumed. console didn't show socket close.

sam: ugh. do we have a trace id/sample?

maria: trace 9f3d1a. console span: https://console/redwood/trace/9f3d1a. ops-bot fired sse.no-output alert. last-event-id kept increasing but clients got no data.

jonathan: could be our keepalive-squelch logic suppressing pings during rekey windows, causing client debounce to avoid reconnecting. that was enabled to cut fanout during noisy network ops.

lee: can you paste the raw request/resp? any proxy half-close hints?

maria: repro curl below (intermittent):

```
curl -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://eu1-api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=gpt-xxx" \
  --max-time 120
```

When rekey happens, TCP session doesn't close, no FIN/RST, but no SSE frames for ~45s then stream resumes mid-response. clients observe a gap and some chat UIs hang.

ops-bot: ALERT sse.no-output spike -> 142 events in 10m (eu1); top tenants: acct-42 acct-77.

sam: metrics show `sse.keepalive_suppressed_total` spikes matching rekey timestamps; `proxy.tls_rekey_count` correlated. sampling low; increasing traces.

jonathan: product input? do we accept resume-with-gap or force reconnect on rekey? we originally avoided reconnect to prevent duplicate billing and replays.

maria: product: prefer graceful resume, but for interactive UIs (chat) gaps are bad. they want a UX fix so resumed chunks are surfaced instead of spinner.

lee: short-term ops: reduce squelch threshold in eu region (0.75 -> 0.5) to lower suppression during rekeys. ops can flip the flag.

sam: I'll open a canary flag and add console banner. also bump tracing sample to 10% for 2 hours.

jonathan: engineering changes we should do: 1) runtime: emit `x-rekey-hint: true` header during rekey windows so clients can treat stall specially; 2) client: implement small stall-to-reconnect heuristic (e.g., if no frames >10s and `x-rekey-hint` set, attempt resume); 3) telemetry: add route/tenant/model labels to keepalive metrics and `sse.stall_duration_seconds` histogram; 4) ops: temporary squelch rollback.

maria: created RB-2219 runbook, owners: maria (investigate), sam (flags/telemetry), jonathan (runtime header), lee (ops). target hotfix today, full fix next release.

lee: ops notes: will roll back and monitor for side effects. sam, post the tracing slices and alert suppression plan in the ticket.

sam: will do. enabling higher sampling and adding metric labels to console dashboard so we can filter per-tenant.

maria: thanks all. I'll follow up with a short postmortem and customer-facing blurb for affected tenants. :thumbsup:
